description: Na₂Ge₂O₅ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four GeO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent GeO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 19°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.62 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four GeO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one GeO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 25-68°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.65 Å. There are two inequivalent Ge sites. In the first Ge site, Ge is bonded to four O atoms to form GeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with three GeO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 39-54°. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.71-1.79 Å. In the second Ge site, Ge is bonded to four O atoms to form GeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with three GeO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid, and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 56-68°. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.70-1.78 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four Na and one Ge atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Ge trigonal bipyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded to four Na and one Ge atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Ge trigonal bipyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Ge atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Ge atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Ge atoms.
